question: Which is the national fruit of Bangladesh?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Jackfruit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jackfruit** is the **national fruit of Bangladesh**.
 
• It is locally known as "**Kathal**" in Bengali.
 
• The **jackfruit tree** is widely grown in Bangladesh and is considered **one of the most abundant fruit trees** in the country.
 
• Jackfruit is celebrated for its **nutritional value** and **economic importance** in Bangladesh.
 
• It is rich in **vitamins**, **minerals**, and **dietary fiber**, making it a highly valued food source.
 
• The fruit has a unique taste and is used in **various traditional dishes**, both ripe and unripe.
 
• The **government of Bangladesh** recognizes its importance and has declared it the **national fruit** to highlight its cultural significance.
 
• Jackfruit is also used for its **wood**, which is valuable for furniture and construction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Apple**__

 __
 
• **Apple** is widely grown in temperate regions and is known for its **cultivation in countries like the USA, China, and India.**
 
• It is a popular fruit globally but does not have a major cultural or agricultural significance in Bangladesh.
 
• Apples are rich in **antioxidants**, **vitamins**, and **dietary fiber**.
 
 
 
• **Mango**__
 __
 
• **Mango** is the **national fruit of India** and is often referred to as the "King of Fruits."
 
• Mango trees are grown in Bangladesh, but it is not the national fruit.
 
• Mangoes are known for their **sweet taste**, **nutritional value**, and use in various **desserts**.
 
 
 
• **Pomegranate**__
 
 
• **Pomegranate** is a fruit that symbolizes **prosperity** and **fertility** in many cultures.
 
• It is grown in arid and tropical regions but is not a significant fruit in Bangladesh.
 
• Pomegranates are rich in **antioxidants** and **vitamin C**.
